questions.question: 统计华北地区的销售总额
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON region_id WHERE province IN ('北京市','天津市','河北省','山西省','内蒙古自治区')

questions.question: 各个省份的销售额分别是多少
questions.expected_sql: SELECT dim_region.province AS 省份, SUM(fact_order.order_amount) AS 销售总额 FROM fact_order JOIN dim_region ON fact_order.region_id = dim_region.region_id GROUP BY dim_region.province

questions.question: GMV是多少
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order
